contract.notes: Letter of 01 Aug 2025 from Dulip de Alwis, Group General Manager – Hotels, "SUMMER 2026 - ALL MARKET RATES"; rooms: Deluxe only. Two printed periods: 01 May – 31 Jul & 01 Sep – 31 Oct 2026 (one season, two ranges) and 01 – 31 Aug 2026 (the Perahera month, priced higher). BB / HB / FB are all printed, so the extra-meal prices are entered as meal prices only, not as meal deltas (the difference between the printed bases is USD 5-15, not the USD 12/14 extra-meal price). The Perahera supplement is printed by occupancy (SGL 55 / DBL 65 / TPL 75) but WITHOUT dates — entered without dates; the Esala Perahera nights must be filled in before the plan is used, otherwise it reads as applying to every night. The sheet does not say the Perahera supplement is compulsory; entered as compulsory because it is charged on those nights.
